newsitem.title: LIECHTENSTEIN: US raids on Iraq could bring anarchy - Primakov.
newsitem.headline: US raids on Iraq could bring anarchy - Primakov.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov, reaffirming Moscow's condemnation of U.S. missile strikes against Iraq, said on Wednesday they could lead to "catastrophic consequences" on the world scene.
Use of force by one country without the approval of the United Nations "could lead to anarchy in international relations," he told reporters in the Liechtenstein capital.
Primakov, speaking after talks with the Alpine principality's foreign minister Andrea Willi, said Russia saw the second round of U.S. attacks on military targets in Iraq "very negatively."
"Such a system could lead to catastrophic consequences," he declared. "I am speaking not only about regional affairs, but about the world order.

"No single country can take action that could disrupt the world order. There is the U.N. Security Council, and only this can decide on using force....No one can disrupt this world order or it could lead to anarchy in international relations."

Primakov's comments followed his criticism of the first wave of U.S. attacks on Iraq, voiced in the Swiss capital of Berne on Tuesday, when he called for the attacks to be halted and suggested they had been launched to boost President Bill Clinton's pre-election domestic political standing.
